items.passage: Questions 1-2 refer to the following e-mail. From: To: promotions@cdworld.com jerry@garcianetworks.com Date: Thursday Feb 24, 2007 Subject: You get $5 off $30! CD World would like to thank you for choosing cdworld.com as your source for music CDs, DVDs, and videos. To show our appreciation we are offering you $5 off your next purchase of $30 or more. Just visit http://www.cdworld.com and choose from the latest releases. But hurry, this offer ends March 31! Coupon Code: 95309UPZVLM Thanks, CD World.
